thesis: The operating franchise is strong, but the large investment gain and incompatible earnings bases prevent judging apparent cheapness. Both sides lack a normalized valuation bridge.
strongest_counterexample: High operating profitability, strong revenue growth and cash generation remain after separating investment gains.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of declining operating profit excluding investment effects.

Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive recurring EPS growth and positive FCF growth after a matched-period valuation reconciliation.
evidence_gaps: Comparable recurring EPS excluding investment marks and capex-return bridge.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Operating margins and cash flow support an established growth business
The operating case survives removal of investment marks, but the valuation case must then use an explicitly normalized earnings denominator
